question: What does this single verse ultimately reveal?
premises: The preceding teaching can be gathered into one verse.
That verse expresses Bhairava as consciousness itself.
Bhairava contains the entire sequence of beings.
inference: Therefore, this single verse clearly explains Bhairava himself as consciousness, full of the entire sequence of beings.
plain_english: Thus this single verse clearly explains Bhairava himself, whose nature is consciousness, full of the entire sequence of all beings.
